H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H4791: altitude, i.e. concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation, figuratively (elation), or adverbially (aloft)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H4397: a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher)
H6635: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
H8121: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement
H3556: a star (as round or as shining); figuratively, a prince
H216: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H1254: (absolutely) to create; (qualified) to cut down (a wood), select, feed (as formative processes)
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H5703: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H2706: an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H8577: a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal
H8415: an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean watersupply)
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H6086: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
H730: a cedar tree (from the tenacity of its roots)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H929: properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective)
H7431: a reptile or any other rapidly moving animal
H3671: an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle
H8269: a head person (of any rank or class)
H8199: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
H970: properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective)
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H1330: a virgin (from her privacy); sometimes (by continuation) a bride; also (figuratively) a city or state
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H5288: (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age)
H7682: to be (causatively, make) lofty, especially inaccessible; by implication, safe, strong; used literally and figuratively
H905: properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of atree, bar forcarrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart, only, besides
H1935: grandeur (i.e. an imposing form and appearance)
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H7161: a horn (as projecting); by implication, a flask, cornet; by resemblance. an elephant's tooth (i.e. ivory), a corner (of the altar), a peak (of a mountain), a ray (of light); figuratively, power
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
